examples.en: The bus is thirty minutes late.

examples.ko: 오늘 서울은 삼십 도예요. 정말 더워요.
examples.en: It's thirty degrees in Seoul today. It's really hot.
A month is about thirty days.

examples.ko: 저는 오늘 책을 삼십 쪽 읽어요.
examples.en: I'm reading thirty pages of a book today.

explain: 30분은 “삼십 분”이라고도 하고 “반”이라고도 해요. 세 시 삼십 분은 “세 시 반”이에요. 영어의 “half past three”와 비슷해요.

phrases.example: 비가 쏟아지자 다들 삼십육계 줄행랑을 쳤어요.
phrases.en: When the rain poured down, everyone ran for it.
phrases.nuance_en: running away in a hurry, usually when things suddenly go wrong
phrases.en_equiv: When the rain poured down, everyone ran for it.

explain_en: Thirty minutes can be 삼십 분 or 반 (“half”). 세 시 삼십 분 is also 세 시 반, just like English “half past three”.

dis.h: Sino-Korean number; for minutes, dates, money

p.n: Both work with 명. But with 분 only 삼십 works, and with 살 only 서른.
